business_problem: The Beijing Humanoid Robot Innovation Center needed more scalable compute, better embodied-intelligence data production, and stronger model reasoning support to build a general-purpose platform that could work across robot bodies, tasks, and scenarios.
solution_summary: The Beijing Humanoid Robot Innovation Center used Baidu AI Cloud's BaiGe GPU compute platform, Qianfan large-model capabilities, and data-collection and labeling services to accelerate embodied-intelligence development. BaiGe provides the AI infrastructure layer that schedules compute efficiently and improves model training and inference performance for the center's daily work on the 'Hui Si Kai Wu' general embodied-intelligence platform. Qianfan and ERNIE-class model capabilities add higher-level reasoning by parsing natural-language instructions, fusing multimodal context, and decomposing complex tasks into executable subtask sequences. At the same time, Baidu's data-services team contributes to the center's national-scale embodied-data program by helping produce and label high-density, high-quality multimodal datasets.
products_used: Embodied Data Collection and Labeling Service

solution_components.name: BaiGe GPU Compute Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the high-performance and stable compute layer for embodied-model training and inference.

solution_components.name: Qianfan Large Model Platform
solution_components.role: Supplies large-model reasoning capabilities for instruction parsing, multimodal understanding, and task decomposition.

solution_components.name: Embodied Data Collection and Labeling Service
solution_components.role: Helps produce and annotate the large, high-density embodied datasets required for platform training.

data_flow: Embodied data from multiple scenes and robot forms is collected and labeled, then fed into the center's training pipelines on BaiGe. Qianfan-backed models interpret instructions and support decision making, and the resulting platform improvements are fed back into new data collection and training cycles.
business_outcome: The center improved embodied-model development efficiency, strengthened robot decision-making, and accelerated creation of a large national embodied-data asset for future robotics applications.
metrics: The center is building a million-scale embodied dataset.
architecture_clues: The solution joins compute scheduling, large-model reasoning, and data-labeling services in one embodied-intelligence stack
The target platform supports many robot bodies and many task types rather than one robot-one task development
The program established national-scale data-collection and training bases for embodied intelligence
